verdict.rationale: Pika's own llms.txt lists an official "Pika MCP" that connects to ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw and other MCP-compatible agents. The homepage describes using its creative apps and models without leaving the conversation, which supports agent-side use. Evidence depth is thin, though: it is a catalog-style listing rather than full documentation. Missing for 10: setup/connection docs (endpoint URL, auth flow), a documented tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
